hypothesis: Test a five-session conditional ridge signal with liquidity-based selection for additions, leaving exits to the signal and risk rules.

research.mechanism: Candle close location and signed volume surprise may distinguish trend continuation from exhaustion, conditional on volatility shock. Eligible assets compete for a bounded set of positions before risk sizing.
research.falsification: Reject if the selector fails to beat the identical ML signal without selection, the signal fails the exposure-matched baseline, or the advantage disappears under higher costs, execution delays or nearby selection settings.
